note: Labelled stall corpus: sessions where the agent waited on a command that never finished, and sessions where it did not. Positives were verified by hand (the user's own words and, where expect lists blocking-wait, a wait tool result that still says the job is running). Negatives were screened mechanically: no wait on a still-running job, no complaint about a stalled run. Read with scripts/measure-stalls.mjs.
